description: Screenshots of the Repsy Open Source panel used by the docs, generated by tools/screenshots (see its README). `name` and `page` never change once a docs page uses them, only the pixels do. `figure` is the `src` for the figure shortcode; `alt` is a suggested alt text; `displayWidth` (phone shots only) is the `width` to pass to the shortcode. `status: pending` means the shot is not generated yet (with a `reason`).
